newsitem.title: USA: Eagle Hardware to open two stores in Q4.
newsitem.headline: Eagle Hardware to open two stores in Q4.

text.p: Eagle Hardware & Garden Inc said Thursday it planned to open two stores during its fourth fiscal quarter of 1996.
The company said in a statement it would open one store near Boulder and another in Pueblo, Colorado.
It said it was also planning to open between five and six stores in the next fiscal year and was "actively reviewing additional sites for future expansion."
The company reported a net income of $0.28 per diluted share for the third quarter against $0.11 during the same period last year.
